QuestionText: Which of these is a place where computers are used to teach students?
Explanation: In schools, teachers use computers to show lessons and students use them to learn.

QuestionText: At the airport, computers are used for _________.
Explanation: Computers help in booking flight tickets and checking plane timings.

QuestionText: Doctors use computers in hospitals to _________.
Explanation: Computers help doctors keep records of health and find out about illnesses.

QuestionText: Which machine is used to take out money from a bank at any time?
Explanation: An ATM (Automated Teller Machine) is a specialized computer for banking.

QuestionText: In shops and malls, computers are used to make _________.
Explanation: Shopkeepers use computers to calculate prices and print bills quickly.

QuestionText: Can we use a computer to listen to music?
Explanation: Computers can play songs and audio files through speakers or headphones.

QuestionText: We can use computers to send electronic messages called _________.
Explanation: E-mail stands for electronic mail, which travels instantly over the internet.

QuestionText: Which of these can be done on a computer?
Explanation: Computers are multi-purpose machines that can do many different tasks.

QuestionText: Computers help scientists to _________.
Explanation: Scientists use powerful computers to predict if it will rain or be sunny.

QuestionText: A smartphone is a type of _________ computer.
Explanation: Smartphones are small computers that we can carry in our pockets.

QuestionText: Where are computers used to keep records of books?
Explanation: Librarians use computers to know which books are borrowed and which are on the shelves.

QuestionText: We can talk to people far away using video calls on a computer. This is _________.
Explanation: Communication means sharing information or talking with others.

QuestionText: Which part of technology helps us find our way on a road trip?
Explanation: GPS (Global Positioning System) uses satellites and computers to show us directions.

QuestionText: What can you NOT do on a computer?
Explanation: A computer is a machine; it cannot perform physical human actions like eating.

QuestionText: Computers in banks help to keep our _________ safe.
Explanation: Banks use computers to track how much money people have in their accounts.

QuestionText: Using the internet to buy things from home is called _________.
Explanation: Online shopping allows us to order items using a computer or phone.

QuestionText: Which device is used to take digital photos?
Explanation: Digital cameras use computer chips to save pictures without using film.

QuestionText: In space stations, computers are used to _________.
Explanation: Astronauts and scientists use computers to fly rockets and study space.

QuestionText: A tablet is operated mostly by _________.
Explanation: Tablets have touchscreens that respond to our finger taps.

QuestionText: Which of these is a 'Smart' home device?
Explanation: Smart devices use technology to follow commands, like turning on lights with your voice.

QuestionText: Computers make our work _________.
Explanation: The main goal of computers is to help us finish tasks accurately and quickly.

QuestionText: Where do we see computers being used to print movie tickets?
Explanation: Cinema halls (theatres) use computers to manage seat bookings and tickets.

QuestionText: Can a computer help you learn a new language?
Options: A) Yes, through apps and videos
C) Only if you are 100 years old
Explanation: Educational software and websites are great for learning new skills.

QuestionText: A robot is a machine controlled by a _________.
Explanation: Robots have built-in computers that tell them how to move and work.

QuestionText: To use the internet, we usually need a _________.
Explanation: A connection like Wi-Fi allows computers to talk to other computers around the world.

QuestionText: In hotels, computers are used to _________.
Explanation: Hotels use computers to check people in and out of their rooms.

QuestionText: Which device do we use to play video games on a TV?
Options: A) Game Console (like PlayStation or Xbox)
Explanation: A game console is a special type of computer made just for playing games.

QuestionText: What does 'VR' stand for in gaming?
Explanation: Virtual Reality (VR) uses technology to make you feel like you are inside a game.

QuestionText: Which computer is used for very heavy work like weather research?
Explanation: Supercomputers are the fastest and most powerful computers in the world.

QuestionText: Can we watch the news on a computer?
Explanation: Computers can stream live TV and news from all over the world.

QuestionText: An 'E-book' is a book that you read on a _________.
Explanation: E-books are digital books read on computers, tablets, or e-readers.

QuestionText: Which of these helps us pay for things without using cash?
Explanation: Cards use computer chips to move money from your bank to the shop.

QuestionText: Computers are used in designing _________.
Explanation: Engineers and designers use computers to plan and draw almost everything we use.

QuestionText: Is it good to spend all day playing computer games?
Options: B) No, we should also play outside and rest our eyes
C) Only if we don't eat
D) Yes, but only in the dark
Explanation: Balance is important; too much screen time can be bad for your health.

QuestionText: A smart watch can _________.
Explanation: Smart watches are wearable computers that do much more than just tell time.

QuestionText: When you buy an airplane ticket online, you get an _________.
Explanation: An E-ticket is a digital version of a paper ticket.

QuestionText: Computers in police stations help to _________.
Explanation: Police use computers to keep records and find information to solve crimes.

QuestionText: Can computers talk to each other?
Options: B) No, they don't have mouths
C) Only if they are the same color
D) Only if they are in the same room
Explanation: A network (like the internet) allows computers to share information.

QuestionText: Which of these is used to store many files and songs?
Explanation: Storage devices like pen drives keep digital information safe for later use.

QuestionText: What should you do if a strange message pops up on your computer?
Explanation: Always ask for help if you see something you don't understand on a screen.

QuestionText: Computers help us to stay _________ with friends far away.
Explanation: Technology helps us stay in touch through messages and calls.

QuestionText: A drone is a type of flying _________.
Explanation: Drones are flying machines controlled by computers and remotes.

QuestionText: Which technology allows you to search for information on anything?
Explanation: The internet is a giant collection of information you can search.

QuestionText: How do computers help in making cartoons?
Options: A) They draw and animate the characters
Explanation: Almost all modern cartoons and animated movies are made using computers.

QuestionText: Where would you see a computer used to check your weight and height?
Explanation: Medical centers use computerized machines to take accurate body measurements.

QuestionText: What is a 'Laptop'?
Options: A) A computer that fits on your lap
B) A computer that is as big as a house
C) A computer made of paper
Explanation: Laptops are portable computers designed to be used on a desk or your lap.

QuestionText: Can we use computers to draw maps?
Options: D) Only if we have a ruler
Explanation: Computers are used to make very accurate maps of the Earth.

QuestionText: Why is it important to use a password on a computer?
Options: B) To keep your information safe
C) To make it look pretty
D) To make it go faster
Explanation: Passwords act like keys to make sure only you can use your computer files.

QuestionText: Which device helps us to 'talk' to a computer with our voice?
Explanation: A microphone records your voice so the computer can hear you.

QuestionText: A computer is a gift of _________ to us.
Explanation: Computers are advanced tools created through scientific research.
